Hungarian city-area membership catalogue
Forrás / Source: Központi Statisztikai Hivatal (KSH)
https://www.ksh.hu/teruleti_szamjel_menu
https://www.ksh.hu/docs/osztalyozasok/teruleti_szamjel/teruleti_szamjelrendszer_struktura_elemei_2026.xlsx

Changes: selected the 24 city-centered groups, excluded non-settlement rows and
the non-city-centered Balaton group; matched names to the application catalogue,
combined Budapest's center and sectors, and generated application IDs/count labels.
Only public registry membership facts are reused; no KSH logo or scholarly article is copied.
